text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 106 units of lamotrigine 150 mg tablets (NDC 62332003971) at 5.8 units per day, providing 18 days of inventory. Corvale General holds 218 units at 7.7 units per day, providing 28 days of inventory. Our current supply is sourced from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Par Health, Inc. lamotrigine extended-release tablets as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-04-29. The discontinued Par Health product (NDC 49884-561-11) differs from our current Alembic-sourced NDC, so the FDA posting does not directly explain our current supply status.

Our position: Current inventory covers 18 to 28 days across sites. The Alembic product label lists two plants: one last inspected and classified NAI on 2024-07-26, and a second (Formulation Division-IV, FEI 3016088083) last inspected and classified VAI on 2024-11-22. No other Alembic supply disruption has been reported. Per protocol, we must verify whether the A-S Medication Solutions offering matches our NDC 62332003971 and confirm its manufacturing site, as its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify A-S Medication Solutions product matches NDC 62332003971 and confirm manufacturing site; requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.
2. Buyer to evaluate Actavis Pharma, Inc. product for NDC match and site confirmation; requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.
3. Buyer to evaluate Advagen Pharma Limited product for NDC match and site confirmation; requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.
4. Buyer to evaluate Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC product for NDC match and site confirmation; requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.
5. Buyer to evaluate Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. product for NDC match and site confirmation; requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
